rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a single static image, but it hedges on expansion stage and introduces some speculative details (e.g., gaps/left-right TE variation, image appearing earlier than lab designation) without clear support.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, male factor, BMI, smoking, first-cycle status, and embryo grade into prognosis and counseling.

Reasoning is mostly logical and well structured, with a plausible implantation estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor inconsistency comes from questioning the morphology while still accepting the 3AA designation.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good-prognosis D5 blastocyst, caution about morphology vs euploidy, and individualized discussion of PGT-A. Small deviations include somewhat broad statements about smoking impact and speculative protocol comments.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, follow-up, and future-cycle review, though some recommendations remain general rather than highly protocol-specific.
